name: read_only_live_account_check
description: Verify the pinned public SDK can authenticate, complete MFA, discover devices, connect, refresh reported shadows, summarize counts, and shut down without write operations or identifier output.
given: An authorized PLACE account with at least one device and runtime-only credentials
when: An authorized person runs uv run python scripts/live_check.py --username <account> outside CI and completes any MFA prompt
then: The command exits zero with connected true and every discovered device represented by reported-state counts only
